_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored.
1. Set target.base_url to the asset you are authorized to test.
2. Set target.marker_header to your HackerOne username.
3. Export the two cookie env vars before running.
NEVER put cookies, tokens or passwords in this file - use headers_from_env.
The harvest groups below are a generic REST shape. Replace them with the real
paths from your own browser traffic: open devtools, use the app normally,
and copy the request URLs the front end actually calls. Guessed endpoints
produce noise and waste your request budget.
NOTE for sevDesk: the web app calls /v5/... (e.g. /v5/user/settings), which is
a different surface from the public /api/v1/ documented API. Test BOTH - they
are separate code paths and will not necessarily enforce the same tenant
checks. Capture /v5/ from devtools XHR traffic, /api/v1/ from the API docs.

A._role: tenant that owns the objects being harvested

B._role: separate tenant that must NOT be able to read A's objects

_comment: One group per object type. 'list' is a collection endpoint you can read as A.
'id_paths' pulls ids out of that response (minimal JSONPath subset).
'detail' is every representation of a single object worth testing - this is
the important part. The plain JSON GET is usually protected; the PDF render,
the embed expansion and the sub-collections often are not.
harvest.name: PrimaryObject
